summary: @servicetitan/marketing-widgets ships install-time dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it via execFileSync against the bundled 727KB `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using string-array rotation (a `WV8StW` shuffle routine), numeric-constant tables, and _0x-style identifier obfuscation, with no readable source or build metadata shipped alongside it. The package advertises itself as a React marketing-widgets component library, a category with no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated executable that runs at install time; the Bun binary is used specifically to execute a payload the Node-native ecosystem's tooling cannot readily introspect. The package name `@servicetitan/marketing-widgets` also diverges from its declared repository (`servicetitan/marketing-integration-widgets`), consistent with scope impersonation of the ServiceTitan organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
